newsitem.title: UK: UK public sector repayment 3.875 bln stg in July.
newsitem.headline: UK public sector repayment 3.875 bln stg in July.

text.p: The UK government repaid 3.875 billion stg of public sector debt in July, the Office for National Statistics said on Monday.
There were no privatisation proceeds but VAT receipts of 5.032 billion stg were the highest since records began.
Deficits, unless noted with minus signs (-).
PSBR (in million stg) July APR/Jul Apr/Jul
Note - there were no privatisation proceeds in July. In July last year receipts totalled 909 million stg.
* July VAT receipts highest since records began. Consensus foreacst was for a 1.9 billion stg PSDR in July.
June's PSBR was revised to 4.64 billion stg from a previously reported 4.754 billion stg.
Last July, there was a PSDR of 929 million stg.
The ONS said in August revenue from tobacco duty is likely to be 1.5 bln stg higher than in the same period last year. This is due to early payment of duty as a result of the July budget.
July also saw increased tobacco duties to the tune of 400 million stg.
Income tax receipts in July of 8.184 bln stg compared with receipts of 7.323 bln in July last year.
Record VAT receipts of 5.032 bln stg compared with the July 1996 total of 3.783 bln.
